events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product discovery, samples, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Bobbi Brown's organizer listing advertises a complimentary VEFB+ sample, refreshments and croissants, scratch-off prizes and giveaways while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite listing is organized by Bobbi Brown Cosmetics and presents the event as a free invitation/registration. Promotional samples, food and prizes are while supplies last. Photo and video content will be captured during the event for Bobbi Brown social/digital channels.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. Use the Bobbi Brown organizer Eventbrite listing to register; arrive early if the deluxe sample is the priority because only the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive it.

events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-day Medik8 skincare pop-up at Sephora SoHo with free samples and personalized skincare consultations. A separate Ariana Madix meet-and-greet takes place September 16 for qualifying purchasers.
events.what_is_free: Current event listings advertise free skincare samples and personalized consultations. The Ariana Madix meet-and-greet is not a general freebie: the first 150 eligible customers who buy two or more full-size Medik8 products on September 16 receive a wristband for the 6–8 PM meet-and-greet.
events.caveats: Free RSVP links are published separately for September 16 and September 17. September 16 public pop-up hours are 12–5:30 PM; the 6–8 PM Ariana Madix meet-and-greet requires a qualifying purchase of two or more full-size Medik8 products and is limited to the first 150 eligible customers. September 17 public pop-up hours are 11 AM–7 PM.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16: 12–5:30 PM public pop-up; RSVP at the September 16 Eventbrite link. Thursday, September 17: 11 AM–7 PM; use the date-specific September 17 Eventbrite link. Do not treat the purchase-gated Ariana meet-and-greet as part of the ordinary free admission.

occurrences.details: Free RSVP via Bobbi Brown organizer Eventbrite; samples, refreshments and giveaways while supplies last.

Free RSVP: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/medik8-x-sephora-is-bringing-age-defying-skincare-directly-to-you-tickets-1999587177074 . Separate 6–8 PM Ariana Madix meet-and-greet requires qualifying purchase and is limited to first 150 eligible customers.
